disable.zh: 关闭后设备恢复原版容量。请先清理额外格子中的物品；旧库存缩容兼容性尚未完整验证。
disable.en: Disabling restores native capacity. Empty added slots first; shrinking existing inventories has not been fully verified.

uninstall.zh: 卸载前请清理额外格子中的物品。
uninstall.en: Empty added inventory slots before uninstalling.

description.zh: 分拣台输入、输出格扩到 15 和 10（可调），沿用原版加工流程。
description.en: Expands recycler input and output slots to 15 and 10 (adjustable) using the native processing.
